title: Umbrous and tender venezuelan pandan-leaf wrap
description: A spicy, tender and refreshing monsoon dish featuring pandan-leaf, khao khua and corn husk wrap, inspired by Venezuelan cuisine.

ingredients.name: khao khua (fried rice)
ingredients.notes: crunchy fried rice made with leftover rice and spices

instructions: Grill the chicken breast until cooked through and let it rest.
Sauté the red onion, coriander, cumin, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper in a pan until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced tomatoes to the pan and cook for another 3 minutes.
Add the khao khua to the pan and stir well to combine with the onion and tomato mixture.
Shred the grilled chicken breast and add it to the pan, stirring well to combine.
Warm the corn husk wraps by wrapping them in a damp cloth and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Spoon the chicken and khao khua mixture onto the center of each wrap.
Top each wrap with a dollop of sour cream and a few leaves of pandan-leaf.
Fold the bottom edge of each wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Serve the wraps hot and enjoy.
